newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland offers 3-yr bonds to public at 99.50 zlotys.
newsitem.headline: Poland offers 3-yr bonds to public at 99.50 zlotys.

text.p: The Polish treasury will sell its three-year index-linked bond, due on February 6, 2000, to the public at an issue price of 99.5 zlotys, the Public Debt Department of the finance ministry said on Tuesday.
It said the three-year bond will be available to the public from February 3 to April 30, 1997.

The treasury cut the price of its bonds, previously at 101.0, because from this year investment in treasury bonds is no longer tax-deductable. It earlier cut the public price of one-year bonds to 96.5 zlotys.
